scope.title: Memory writes correlate with the RC-04 EffectReceipt recovery loop
scope.source: real EffectReceiptStore + real RuntimeMemoryStore (no live provider)

decision.reason: Memory self-edit writes now record digest-only effect receipts through the real RC-04 store: one row per write, deterministic per-intent idempotency (replay -> duplicate, 0 duplicate effects), outcome applied/not_applied/unknown preserved, fail-open. Regression 86 tests pass.

effectLoop.sink: RC-04 EffectReceiptStore (structural MemoryEffectReceiptSink; runtime-core does not import agents/ at runtime)
effectLoop.idempotencyKey: memory-effect:v1:<sha256(action|factId|sessionKey|runId|toolCallId)> - outcome-independent, so a replayed intent is a duplicate

residual.productionAssembly: The sink must be injected; the production wiring that attaches the RC-04 store to the memory tool context is left to the integration layer (this packet does not register the tools).
residual.readTools: memory_recall / memory_find_related are read-only and produce no effect receipt.
residual.scope: Runtime memory self-edit only; no change to default auto-writeback, product defaults, locks, or approval semantics.

independentVerification.detail: The real EffectReceiptStore writes a row for a real memory_update and treats a replay as identical-content duplicate; the builder unit test asserts digest-only proposals, outcome-independent keys, fail-open, and unknown preservation. No separate second-agent verifier role was run.

acceptanceCriteria.note: Reuses RC-04 EffectReceiptStore (append-only, idempotency unique, identical-content vs conflict); no second effect store.
proposal carries identifiers only; no memory content, credentials, or raw payload.
stage1Context carries actor (sessionKey/runId/attempt/modelCall) and effect (toolCallId/toolName/resource/action); the store returns an effectReceiptId.
Replaying the same intent hits the same idempotency key and returns duplicate:true with the same effectReceiptId; 0 duplicate effects.
applied / not_applied / unknown mapped explicitly; a partial failure is recorded unknown, never disguised as applied.
A missing or throwing sink never blocks or fails the memory write.
5 new + 86 regression tests pass, tsgo:core 0, scoped lint 0, harness validate/dry-run pass, comms 0, credential scan 0 hits, SHA256SUMS verifiable.

notMeasured: Production assembly of the RC-04 sink into the agent tool context.
A separate second-agent independent verifier role.

landing.note: Pushed with the evidence commit in the same session; see the branch's PR.
